sv.title: Svenska donerade 170 miljoner till Louisiana
sv.summary: Svenska Kristina Nielsen har tillsammans med sin danske make Mogens Deickmann donerat drygt 170 miljoner kronor till Louisiana.

en.title: Swedish couple donates SEK 170 million to Louisiana
en.summary: Swede Kristina Nielsen and her Danish husband Mogens Deickmann have donated just over SEK 170 million to Louisiana.
